prompt: GNU diff expand-tabs encoding error column width treatment
answer:
GNU `diff`’s `--expand-tabs` (`-t`) option converts tabs to the appropriate number of spaces, using tab stops normally every 8 display columns; `--tabsize=columns` changes that interval.

For column widths, `diff` consults the current locale to determine each character’s width. An encoding error—an input byte that is not part of any character—is treated as occupying one column.
